not_fixed.why: The defect is real but fails safe: every call a mapper helper makes is denied, because {attempt} never renders in the coordinator's folder. The documents disagree about what the mapper is, so it needs a ruling, not an edit. The design (protocol R55 'A mapper helper maps findings'; its role table line 320 'Coordinator ... Agent (checker, mapper)') and spec/guard-hook.mjs.md line 80 (coordinator agent_types: checker, mapper) make it a helper the coordinator starts. CONTRACT line 298, spec/replace.mjs.md lines 97 and 195 (T20b), spec/gate.mjs.md and spec/briefs.md make it a design-check task role with its own attempt folder and built inputs (in/stpa.json, in/fmea.json, in/cut.md). Each fix the review offers contradicts one side. Dropping mapper from coordinator.json and settings/coordinator.json contradicts the guard-hook spec table and the design. A {root}-anchored helper profile needs a second profile for the role name mapper, which the one-profile-per-role layout does not allow. Recommendation for the coordinator: rule that mapper is the design-check task role. Then drop mapper from the coordinator's agent_types and its Agent(mapper) allow rule, amend spec/guard-hook.mjs.md line 80 and the protocol's line 320 / R55, and add a T6 case: coordinator Agent mapper gives agent-type.

An equivalent mutant, so no test can kill it. NUM_RE always matches at the first digit of a run: \d+ is greedy with an optional decimal part and (?!\d), so a match never starts right after an unconsumed digit. The only start after a digit is a sign glued to it (3-5), and there start moves to bodyStart, whose previous character is the sign. The skip on witness.mjs line 186 can never fire.
